{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and filter out the six QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop the QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now, filter for loyal customers only
loyal_df = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders among loyal customers
conversion_rate = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

print(f"Number of loyal customers: {len(loyal_df)}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal orders: {loyal_df['converted'].sum()}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate}")"}
